objectives.name: Navigation and EVA under low sun

presets.label: Cloud ≤30%, wind chill ≥ −40 °C
presets.warning: Very high frostbite risk: Environment Canada warns that exposed skin can freeze in 5–10 minutes at a wind chill of −40 °C.

presets.label: Cloud ≤50%, wind chill ≥ −40 °C
presets.warning: Very high frostbite risk: Environment Canada warns that exposed skin can freeze in 5–10 minutes at a wind chill of −40 °C.

rule.snow_unknown: treated as snow-covered, so the stricter wind limit applies
rule.day: local mean solar day (UTC + longitude / 15 h); a stretch belongs to the day that holds its midpoint
rule.wind_chill: Environment Canada / US NWS formula, 2 m air temperature and 10 m wind

levels.match: Holds on at least 80% of days or hours. Terrain: the slope distributions differ by at most 20 points at any slope
levels.partial: Holds on 20% to 80%. Terrain: the slope distributions differ by at most 50 points
levels.breaks_down: Holds on under 20%, or differs in kind from the target. Terrain: the slope distributions differ by more than 50 points

weather_cell_classes.representative: At least half of the weather grid cell is bare land.
weather_cell_classes.mixed: Less than half of the weather grid cell is bare land; the rest is land ice or ocean. Temperature and wind can differ from the bare-ground site by a few degrees.
weather_cell_classes.not_representative: The weather grid cell is ice sheet with no bare land. At the two Antarctic sites checked against stations it is 7–12 °C colder in summer than the bare-ground site. Temperature, wind chill and usable days describe the ice next to the site and are too pessimistic.

fidelity_rows.label: Sun elevation in the target band
Speed of the Sun across the sky
fidelity_rows.note: The Sun moves about 15° per hour on Earth and about 0.5° per hour on the Moon, so shadows turn about 30 times faster.

fidelity_rows.label: Black sky, no light in shadows
fidelity_rows.note: Earth's air scatters light into shadows and dims and reddens the low Sun. On the Moon shadows are black and the Sun is at full strength.

fidelity_rows.label: Terrain slope
fidelity_rows.note: Slope on a 40 m grid in a 10 km box: LOLA at the target, the Copernicus DEM at the site. Match when the share of ground below any slope differs by 20 points or less (partial: 50). Roughness is not compared yet.

fidelity_rows.label: Clear sky for direct sunlight
fidelity_rows.note: The Moon has no cloud. On Earth a low-sun window needs a clear line of sight to the Sun.

fidelity_rows.label: Wind chill within the crew limit

sun.name: Calculated sun position (NOAA solar calculator algorithm, after Meeus)
sun.detail: Apparent elevation with NOAA refraction, flat horizon, 5-minute steps. Checked against NREL SPA.

merra2_const.name: MERRA-2 M2C0NXASM v5.12.4 (surface type fractions and height)
merra2_const.detail: Share of bare land, land ice, ocean and lake in each weather grid cell, and the cell's surface height.

merra2_slv.name: MERRA-2 M2T1NXSLV v5.12.4 (T2M, U10M, V10M)
merra2_slv.detail: Hourly 2 m air temperature and 10 m wind. Grid 0.5° × 0.625°. NASA GES DISC through Earthdata OPeNDAP.

ceres_cloud.name: CERES SYN1deg cloud amount, through the NASA POWER hourly API (CLOUD_AMT)
ceres_cloud.detail: Hourly total cloud amount. Grid 1°. Cloud detection over snow and ice is uncertain.

merra2_precip.name: MERRA-2 bias-corrected precipitation, through the NASA POWER hourly API (PRECTOTCORR)
merra2_precip.detail: Hourly precipitation. Grid 0.5° × 0.625°. Poleward of 62.5° this is model output without gauge correction.

modis_snow.name: MODIS/Terra Snow Cover Monthly L3 Global 0.05° CMG (MOD10CM) v061
modis_snow.detail: Mean snow cover of the 5 × 5 pixels (about 25 km) around the site. Antarctica is mapped as snow by design, so it is not measured there.

lola_dem.name: LRO LOLA polar elevation model LDEM_80S_40M (PDS Geosciences Node)
lola_dem.detail: South polar stereographic, 40 m pixels, gridded from LOLA altimetry. Read in a 10 km box around each target.

copernicus_dem.name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (ESA, AWS Open Data copy)
copernicus_dem.detail: 30 m surface model from TanDEM-X, averaged onto a 40 m grid in a 10 km box around each site. Glacier and snow surfaces count as terrain.

terrain.method: Horn slope on a 40 m grid in a 10 km x 10 km box centred on each target and site. steep_share is the share steeper than 15°. hist_share bins: 2° wide from 0° to 40°, then one bin above. ks is the Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance between a site's and a target's slope distributions.
